name: Benzatropine
reason: Benzatropine (benztropine) is an anticholinergic for Parkinson's disease and drug-induced movement disorders. Neither Wikipedia nor Grokipedia nor the PubMed/trial listings document any use for sweating or any appearance or looksmaxxing context (anhidrosis appears only as an adverse effect), and the available PubMed hits are off-topic.
